title: Basic Negotiations
completion_message: ¡Trato hecho! Has aprendido el vocabulario esencial para llevar a cabo una negociación básica en inglés.

parts.visual: Términos clave: Make an offer (Hacer una oferta). Accept / Reject (Aceptar / Rechazar). Reach a deal (Llegar a un acuerdo). Compromise (Llegar a un punto medio / Ceder).
parts.audio: Key terms. Make an offer. Accept or Reject. Reach a deal. Compromise means to find a middle ground.

parts.visual:
Frases útiles: That is out of the question (Eso es imposible / innegociable). 
We need to find a middle ground (Necesitamos encontrar un punto medio). 
It's a win-win situation (Es una situación en la que ambos ganan). 
Let's shake on it (Cerremos el trato con un apretón de manos).
parts.audio: Useful phrases. That is out of the question. We need to find a middle ground. It's a win-win situation. Let's shake on it.

stages.title: Interactive Quiz
stages.description: Elige la palabra correcta para completar el diálogo o concepto de negociación.

questions.question: I would like to make you an ____. (Oferta).
questions.explanation: Make an offer = hacer una oferta.

questions.question: If you lower the price, we will ____ the offer. (Aceptar).
Unfortunately, we have to ____ your proposal. (Rechazar).
I'm glad we could ____ a deal today. (Llegar a un acuerdo).
questions.explanation: Reach a deal = llegar a un acuerdo (alcanzar un trato).

questions.question: Neither of us got exactly what we wanted, but we reached a ____. (Punto medio / Acuerdo mutuo cediendo).
questions.explanation: Compromise = ceder para llegar a un punto medio. (Falso amigo: no significa 'compromiso' de obligación).

questions.question: A 50% discount is ____ of the question. (Imposible / Innegociable).
questions.explanation: Out of the question = totalmente imposible.

questions.question: We need to find a ____ ground to make this work. (Punto medio).
questions.explanation: Find a middle ground = encontrar un punto medio.

questions.question: This agreement benefits both of us. It's a ____ situation. (Ganar-Ganar).
questions.explanation: Win-win situation = situación donde ambas partes ganan.

questions.question: Let's ____ on it to close the deal. (Dar un apretón de manos).
questions.explanation: Shake on it = darse la mano (para cerrar un trato).

questions.question: What is your ____ line? (El mínimo aceptable / Lo último que puedes aceptar).
questions.explanation: Bottom line = el precio o condición mínima aceptable.

questions.question: If we buy in bulk, can you give us a ____? (Descuento).
We are willing to ____ on the delivery time, but not on the price. (Negociar/Discutir).
Since they rejected our offer, we made a ____. (Contraoferta).
I will have to ____ this over with my boss before saying yes. (Consultarlo / Hablarlo).
questions.explanation: Talk this over = discutirlo/consultarlo con alguien.

questions.question: Before we sign, let's review the ____ and conditions. (Términos).
questions.explanation: Terms and conditions = términos y condiciones.

questions.question: I think we have a ____. (Trato / Acuerdo).
questions.explanation: We have a deal = tenemos un trato.

questions.question: You drive a ____ bargain! (Eres duro negociando).
questions.explanation: Drive a hard bargain = ser un negociador duro o exigente.

questions.question: Let's put our cards on the ____. What do you really want? (Ser honestos / Jugar limpio).
questions.explanation: Put our cards on the table = poner las cartas sobre la mesa (ser transparente).

questions.question: We are deadlocked. We need a ____ to move forward. (Solución/Acuerdo).
questions.explanation: Breakthrough = avance importante (para salir de un punto muerto).

questions.question: Let's get down to ____. (Ir al grano / Empezar a hablar de negocios en serio).
questions.explanation: Get down to business = ir al grano (empezar a trabajar/negociar).
